title: *Almgren* wins NYC Marathon debut
hook: Sweden's Andreas Almgren and Kenya's Sheila Chepkirui win New York.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: Andreas Almgren (SWE) won the men's race on his marathon debut. Sheila Chepkirui (KEN) took the women's title, her second in NYC.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: Crippa was 2nd (2:06:14), Mofolo 3rd (2:06:26). Chepkirui ran 2:24:36, six seconds clear of Jessica McClain (USA).

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: Almgren, the World Half Marathon champion, won on his first marathon. Reportedly McClain's second place is the first US women's podium since 2018.

sources: The Independent via Yahoo Sports, 1 Nov 2026

facts.claim: Chepkirui 2:24:36, 6s ahead of McClain; second NYC title
Almgren World Half Marathon champion, marathon debut
McClain first US women's podium since 2018 (reportedly)

caption:
NEWS: Almgren wins NYC Marathon on his debut

Andreas Almgren (SWE) won the 2026 New York City Marathon in 2:06:01 on his marathon debut; Sheila Chepkirui (KEN) won the women's race in 2:24:36, six seconds ahead of Jessica McClain (USA). Results as of 1 Nov 2026.

Source: Marathon Journal, The Independent
